svg.text: RiskSearcher x Circle Arc - Detailed Integration
ETHOnline 2026 - Circle Arc - Treasury / FX Track (Continuity)
1. Identity + authenticated session - Circle Modular Wallets + backend proof
Face ID / Touch ID / Windows Hello /
security key - one tap, no OAuth setup
identity only; treasury funds remain in Stage 2 DCW
confirmed live: a cache wipe still
resolves the SAME wallet via ref_id,
never a silent new empty one
3. Arc Testnet funding + paid scan access
Current testnet funding path = Circle faucet
No fake fiat purchase or withdrawal
success states are shown to users
Mainnet rails are a roadmap item,
Credits are granted only after Circle confirms
4. Why USDC specifically - not ETH, not a card processor
A fixed price needs a fixed asset
price every time the market moves -
tx confirming, or day to day for the
Predictable for both sides, by construction
A usage-based dev tool with global
users doesn't fit card rails well:
no chargebacks to dispute, no per-
cut, and no country allowlist deciding
USDC is Arc's native gas asset too
Arc uses USDC to pay gas directly -
not an ERC-20 bolted onto an ETH-gas
chain. The same balance a user tops
up for scans is the same balance that
pays their transaction gas - one asset,
not two the user has to separately
One balance, not a gas-token side quest
5. Mainnet-Ready - one env var, not a code change
ARC_BLOCKCHAIN="ARC-TESTNET" (default) -> "ARC" - reaches wallet creation, wallet lookup, AND every transfer
Cache keys are namespaced by network too, so a mainnet switch can never accidentally reuse a cached testnet wallet
6. Roadmap to Mainnet — bootstrap + launch hardening
Personal funds and/or hackathon prize winnings
domain · paid infra/API capacity · legal setup
Two distinct Circle products, one flow: Modular Wallets (passkey identity) feeds Developer-Controlled Wallets (real treasury) via ref_id.
Real Arc Testnet balance + subscription payment are implemented today; on/off-ramp stays Coming Soon. Stage 6 is a bootstrap plan, not an external raise.
Mainnet launch costs are planned from personal bootstrapping and/or hackathon prize winnings. See README §10.2/§10.5 and architecture.svg.
